_doc: Which of the shared AI composer's controls Cloud Tools Small LLMs enables (libs:ai assets/ai/ai-design.json defines them and their order). A TASK, never a model, picks the model here (task_required: the chat is always on a task), so Agent and Model are always the greyed chips of the task's mapping; no Mode, MCP or Effort because the app's router calls the model itself. More carries Usage & Cost from the Costs ledger. ToolsComposerTest holds this to the design.
